name: catalog_ingestion_agent
description: Ingests new applications into the managed services catalog by retrieving wiki/Confluence/MyWiki documentation, mapping data to the catalog schema, and creating or updating app.yaml + companion docs automatically.
welcomeMessage:
📦 Catalog Ingestion Agent ready!

I'll help you add or update an application in the managed services catalog.

Let's start — What is the BAPP ID? (e.g., BAPP0012680)
